name: MX

images.credit: NeriDavide, CC BY 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Announced / released: China & Hong Kong only, 2012-02-01, (First Dual-core model), 2012-06-30, (Quad-core model), 2012-07-14, (New Dual-core model)

Network.Technology: 2G GSM/GPRS/EDGE: 850, 900, 1800, 1900 MHz Class 12, 3G UMTS/HSPA+/W-CDMA: 850, 900, 1700, 1900, 2100 MHz, HSDPA: 21.6 Mbps, HSUPA: 5.76 Mbps

Body.Other: microSIM only (adapter provided), Gorilla Glass display panel, active noise cancellation, no FM radio

Platform.Operating system: Flyme OS, based on Android 2.3.5 Gingerbread upgradable to Android 4.1.2 Jellybean
Platform.Chipset: Exynos 4 Dual 45 nm, (First dual core model), Exynos 4 Quad 32 nm, (Quad core model), Exynos 4 Dual 32 nm, (new dual core model) or ARM Logic11 in Dual 32 nm, (Texas Instruments in 4.1.2 jellybean mode)
Platform.CPU: 1.4 GHz ARM Cortex-A9 or 1.2 GHz ARM Cortex-A9 + 400 MHz Logic11
Platform.GPU: ARM Mali-400 MP (Quad-Core) or PowerVR SGX 540

Memory.Storage: 16 GB flash memory (Dual-core models), 32 or 64 GB flash memory (Quad-core model)

Display.Display: 4.0 inch diagonal ASV, 640x960 px (288 ppi), 16M colours

Cameras.Rear camera: 8.0 MP, autofocus, LED flash, HD video recording

Battery.Battery: 1600 mAh Li-Ion rechargeable battery, not replaceable, (First dual core model), 1700 mAh Li-Ion rechargeable battery, not replaceable, (New dual core model and Quad-core model) or 1800 mAh Rechargeable but not replaceable battery

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3.5 mm TRS connector, Bluetooth 2.1 with A2DP and EDR, WiFi/WAPI (802.11 b/g/n), microUSB On-The-Go with MHL
